lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: Cadet!

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: If you're free later, come and swing by the Peony Association.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: I have something to give you.
What is it?

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: A badge.
What for?

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: It's actually a badge that every member of the Peony Association carries.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: So as long as you carry this badge, no one will mess with you.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: I thought it would be prudent for you to carry one as well.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: In case you're worried about it looking weird or tacky,

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: fear not!

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: It's got an imprint of a golden dragon on it.
What made you decide on a dragon?

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: Oh right, I guess you wouldn't know.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: The golden dragon is the symbol of the Peony Association.
... Not the peony flower?

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: I can see why you'd think that.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: Despite our name,

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: the peony flower is in fact not our symbol.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: Flowers are weak and fragile,

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: so a long time ago, my grandfather decided to change our symbol to a dragon.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: Dragons symbolize wealth, power,

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: and longevity.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: I have it engraved on my clothes and my weapon.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: When my grandfather was alive, this symbol was reserved strictly for the boss.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: It was forbidden for just about anyone else to wear this symbol.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: I never quite understood that, myself.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: Subordinates are an indispensable part of any organization.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: Without them, I wouldn't be the boss of anything.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: That's why I decided not to hoard the symbol for myself.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: At first, I tried to have it sewn onto the clothing of all my subordinates,

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: but Jin and the others were all against it.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: They clutched their pearls and said it was against tradition,

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: how it'd obscure what should be the clear hierarchy between a boss and their subordinates.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: Blah blah blah, and so it went.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: So I just went and made a badge.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: Haha.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: No one had a problem with that.
That's very kind of you.
You're so cool.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: Huh?

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: You call this kindness?

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: I just think it's the natural thing to do.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: If a team wins a competition,

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: that doesn't mean the leader should be the only one who gets the prize.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: Haha.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: Hearing you say that gives me a real ego boost.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: Be assured that I'll have your back going forward.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: You can always depend on me. Always.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: Cadet,

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: I consider you family,

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: so I hope you'll accept this badge.
I will, thank you.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: Good!

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: Just let me know when you're free,

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: and I'll be waiting for you.
